responsibility: This file implements GCC’s post-reload GCSE-style pass that removes fully or partially redundant loads introduced by reload and later RTL transforms. It hashes load/store memory expressions, records available occurrences that remain valid to block end, optionally computes block transparency, searches predecessor blocks for profitable insertion points, emits compensating loads or copies on edges or in cold places, and deletes now-redundant loads. Its focus is cleanup of spill-related and post-allocation load redundancy after reload has fixed register assignments.
